results.description:
You didn't plan to become a caregiver. You just loved someone.

Now you're the one holding the appointment letter, the medication list, and the group chat nobody answers.

You're the one calling to check whether anyone visited. The one who knows what three different people promised to do this week.

There are days it feels like too much. Days when you wish someone else would step up, even for an hour. That feeling is not a failure. It's what happens when one person carries more than one person should.

The hardest part is not the doing. It is the knowing: being the one who always holds the full picture, because it lives only in your head.

KinCarer puts that picture somewhere the whole care circle can see it.

One shared schedule for tasks, visits and appointments. Check-ins so everyone knows someone arrived, without anyone having to call. A chat beside the schedule, where any message can become a task in two taps. Routines and medication notes, so whoever visits next knows what's needed. Care Files for the documents that matter, somewhere the whole circle can find them.

When the picture is shared, the load is shared. Not just the doing, but the knowing.

WHO KINCARER IS FOR
Families caring for an aging parent.
Brothers and sisters sharing the care from different states.
Partners caring for someone with dementia or a chronic condition.
Families caring alongside paid caregivers or a home care agency.
Anyone who has become the one who holds the full picture.

SHARED SCHEDULE
Add tasks, visits, appointments and reminders so everyone in the care circle can see what needs doing, who is doing it, and what has already happened.

CHECK-INS
Let the care circle know when someone has arrived at the care location. Turn on automatic check-ins and it takes one tap when a phone notices the arrival. KinCarer does not show live movement.

CIRCLE CHAT
Family and caregivers talk beside the schedule, not in another app. Anything decided in the chat can become a task or appointment in two taps, so nothing important gets buried.

ROUTINES AND MEDICATION
Keep daily routines, medication notes and care preferences together, so the next person helping knows what's needed.

HANDOVER NOTES
Leave an update after visits, appointments or changes so everyone stays in the loop without repeating the same messages.

CARE FILES
Store doctor's letters, care plans, photos and other documents in one place, so your care circle can find what matters when they need it.

CLARA AI ASSISTANT
Ask Clara what happened today, who checked in, or what is still waiting for someone. Clara answers only from what your circle has written down. Clara is optional and does not give medical advice.

CARE CIRCLE
Invite family members, friends, neighbors or paid caregivers. Roles and permissions help make sure people see the right information for how they are helping.

ONE SUBSCRIPTION FOR THE WHOLE CIRCLE
Family+ is one plan for the whole care circle, paid monthly or yearly, with 14 days free on the yearly plan. One subscription covers everyone: there is no member limit, and everyone you invite joins free. If Family+ ends, the circle becomes read-only until someone renews. Nothing is deleted.

KinCarer does not replace the love, judgment or care you already give. It helps you organize it, share it and feel less alone carrying it.

Download KinCarer and share the load.

Important: KinCarer is a family care coordination and planning app. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, emergency response, safeguarding services or professional care services. Clara AI provides organizational support only and should not replace advice from qualified professionals.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in your App Store settings.

Privacy Policy: https://kincarer.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

results.description:
CareCircle is a family caregiver app and elderly care organizer for people caring for aging parents, seniors, partners or loved ones, including those living with dementia or long-term conditions. Keep medications, care notes, tasks, appointments, daily care logs and caregiver handoffs in one shared place, so everyone involved knows what happened and what still needs doing.

CARE FOR AGING PARENTS TOGETHER
Family care is easier when everyone works from the same information. Create a private care circle, invite relatives or paid carers, and coordinate care without scattered messages, paper notes or repeated phone calls.

SHARED CAREGIVER ORGANIZER AND CARE COORDINATION
• Add family members and carers to one care circle
• Use administrator, caregiver and viewer roles
• Keep caregiver tasks, appointments and schedules together
• Leave clear caregiver handoffs between visits or shifts
• Let long-distance family members stay informed

MEDICATION TRACKER AND PILL REMINDERS
Keep medication schedules, pill reminders and dose history together. Record who gave a dose and when, so the family caregiver arriving next can see the latest record.

DAILY CARE LOG AND NOTES
Record care notes, symptoms and observed vitals such as blood pressure, temperature and weight. Build a clear daily care log the family can review without searching through chats or notebooks.

TASKS, APPOINTMENTS AND CAREGIVER SCHEDULE
Use the shared calendar for care tasks and appointments. A caregiver schedule and task list help family members divide responsibilities and see what still needs attention.

HANDOFFS AND SHARED CARE
Create a caregiver handoff when another person is taking over. Shared care notes make the transition clearer and reduce the need to reconstruct the day from messages.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION IN ONE PLACE
• Documents such as letters, discharge summaries and care plans
• Emergency profile and important contacts
• Care-team contacts and supplies
• Printable PDF reports

BUILT FOR REAL DAYS
• Works offline and syncs when a connection returns
• Medication reminders
• Large-text and high-contrast options
• Face ID / Touch ID lock
• English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Polish and Portuguese

FREE AND PREMIUM
Free includes one care recipient, two caregivers, unlimited medications and care records, and retained history.

Premium supports up to 10 care recipients and 25 caregivers, more care-team contacts, larger document storage, temporary share links and advanced reports. A 7-day free trial is available.

CareCircle is an organizational record-keeping tool for senior care and home care, not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat or provide medical advice, and it cannot contact emergency services. Always consult a healthcare professional for medical advice. In an emergency, contact your local emergency service.

SUBSCRIPTION
CareCircle Premium is an auto-renewable subscription with a 7-day free trial.
Monthly: USD 7.99 per month. Annual: USD 59.99 per year. Prices may vary by region.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings after purchase.

results.description:
Caring for someone you love, together with your family? With CareWall everyone knows what is going on and who does what, without endless messages and loose lists.

ONE CARE CIRCLE, EVERYONE IN THE LOOP
Create a care circle for your mother, father, grandma or grandpa and invite the family. Everyone sees the same: what happens today, what still needs doing and how things are going.

WHO DOES WHAT? EVERYONE KNOWS
• A shared schedule: add moments and let family members say who goes.
• A calendar with appointments at the GP, the hospital or the hairdresser.
• Tick off tasks and medication together, so nobody does anything twice or forgets.

NEED A HAND? ASK YOUR FAMILY

STAY CLOSE, EVEN FROM FAR AWAY
Share an update or a photo in the care feed, react to each other and chat with the whole care circle or one person.

ALL CARE DETAILS IN ONE PLACE
The care file with contacts, appointments, medical details and documents. Plus short courses (in Dutch) about caring for a loved one and an assistant that thinks along.

SAFE AND PRIVATE
Only the people you invite see your care circle.

FREE TO START
Start free with one care circle and two members. More family members or more care circles? Choose Family Pro: unlimited, with a 14-day free trial first.

FOR CARE PROFESSIONALS
Does your home care organisation use Nedap Ons? Then care professionals can use CareWall too, for their route, clients and reports.

results.releaseNotes: 説明文と翻訳を更新し、スペイン語（メキシコ）に対応しました。
results.description:
今日は予定どおりに進んでいますか？　もし違うなら、誰に知らせるべきでしょう？

InHomeLogは、在宅介護のためのケアオーガナイザーです。毎日のチェックリスト、カレンダー、日用品、お薬、好み、ケアスタッフからのメッセージを、ひとつの共有ケア記録にまとめます。訪問するケアスタッフは必要なことがすぐにわかり、あなたはそれが済んだことを確認できます。隣の部屋にいても、遠く離れて暮らしていても。

高齢の親や配偶者、大切な家族を自宅で介護するご家族と、それを支える在宅のケアスタッフのために作りました。

家族介護の経験から生まれました
InHomeLogは、会議室ではなく台所のテーブルから生まれました。創業者は長年、高齢の両親を自宅で介護してきました。在宅のケアスタッフとの調整、お薬や通院の管理、日用品の補充、そしてどのスタッフに何を伝えたかを覚えておくこと。大事な情報はメッセージや付箋、自分の記憶の中にしかなく、抜け漏れがあるたびに飲み忘れや重複した買い物、仕事中の不安な電話につながりました。InHomeLogは、そのとき彼が欲しかったツールです。

3人で、ひとつのケア記録
ケアマネージャー：在宅介護を計画し、様子を確認します。多くは成人した子どもや配偶者、ときには専門のコーディネーターです。
ケアを受ける人：自宅でケアを受ける方。たとえば高齢の親など。日課や必要なこと、日用品がひとつにまとまります。
ケアスタッフ：自宅でケアを行い、今日のタスクを確認して報告します。

使い方
設定：ケアする方を登録し、毎日の日課、お薬、アレルギー、好き嫌い、家にある日用品を入力します。
招待：在宅のケアスタッフを追加します。スタッフは自分のアカウントでログインするか、あなたが用意した端末で個人のアクセスコードを入力するだけです。
ケア：ケアスタッフは今日のチェックリストを進め、写真やメモを添え、日用品を数え、いつもと違うことがあれば知らせます。
状況を把握：どこにいても、完了したこと、遅れていること、対応が必要なことがわかります。

ケア記録の内容
チェックリスト：時間と担当者つきの、ケアスタッフの毎日のタスク。
カレンダー：通院、ケアスタッフの訪問、予定。
日用品：在庫と残り少ないもの。
好み・制限：食事、日課、アレルギー、食事制限。
お薬：何を、いつ飲むか。
メッセージ：健康に関するメモや日用品のリクエストが直接届きます。

あらゆる在宅介護に
ひとりで介護する方：チェックリストと日用品を整理し、助けが必要になったらケアスタッフを追加できます。
ケアチームをまとめる方：複数のケアスタッフとケアを受ける人を、ひとつの画面で調整できます。
コードを持つケアスタッフ：アカウントは不要。コードを入力すれば今日のタスクが見られます。

ケアスタッフそれぞれの言語で
InHomeLogは英語、スペイン語、フランス語、ドイツ語、オランダ語、イタリア語、ポルトガル語、日本語、韓国語に対応。ケアスタッフ一人ひとりが、いちばん使いやすい言語で使えます。

抜け漏れも心配も、もっと少なく
「お母さんにお薬、誰か飲ませた？」はもう不要
重複した買い物や空っぽの棚とはさようなら
新しいスタッフのたびに同じ説明を繰り返す必要もありません

無料で始める
無料プランでは、1人分の毎日のチェックリスト、好み、日用品を管理できます。介護の必要に合わせてアップグレードできます。

In Home Logをダウンロードして、在宅介護チームのみんなに一日の様子をはっきり届けましょう。

I'm Alive is a simple daily check-in for people who live on their own. Once a day, at a time you choose, tap "I'm Okay". If you miss it, you're reminded first, and if you still don't respond, the person you chose is alerted.

Made for:
• People who live independently and want to keep it that way
• Adult children checking on a parent without calling every day
• Solo travelers

• Pick your check-in time
• Tap once in the app or from your Home Screen widget
• Miss it, and you're reminded, then your contact is alerted
• Check in late and they're told you're OK
• Your contact doesn't need the app

Running late? Contacts who use the app can see your recent phone activity, like when you opened the app or unplugged your phone, for peace of mind. It's for reference only: it never counts as a check-in and never stops an alert.

Free: daily check-in, 1 contact, reminders, and 1 missed check-in alert a month by email.

Paid plans add up to 10 contacts, text alerts (where available), extra check-in times, SOS, fall detection (beta), journey check-ins and an AI voice check-in call. Lifetime is a one-time purchase.

No wearable, no cameras, no constant location tracking. We don't sell your data.

I'm Alive is not a medical device or emergency service and does not contact emergency services for you.

results.description:
Caring for someone you love should never feel lonely.

When someone you love needs more support, the family around them is often far apart. Different towns. Different schedules. The quiet worry of not being there. WarmNote gives your family one warm, private place to stay close, so no one carries it alone.

For the person at the heart of it all
Their screen is calm and simple. Big buttons. Kind words. One gentle thing at a time. With a single tap they can share how they are feeling today. Or they can just speak, and WarmNote writes it down for them. No typing. No fuss. Just their voice, heard.

For the family who cannot always be there
You see the small moments as they happen. A photo from this morning. A note that lunch went down well. How mum slept last night. The little things that tell you she is okay, even from far away.

So nothing is ever missed
Medicines, appointments and doctor visits all live in one place. Everyone can see what has been done and what is coming up. That quiet worry of "did someone remember?" finally settles.

Safe, and only for your family
Your circle is invite only. What you share stays between the people you trust. Your information is never sold and never used for advertising. Carers see only what they need to help, and your family's private notes stay in the family.

Care feels lighter when you carry it together.
That is what WarmNote is for.

WarmNote is free for a circle of up to 2 people.
Family plan: up to 6 members.
Extended plan: up to 15 members.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled. You can manage or cancel anytime in your store account settings.

results.description:
One calm place for your ageing parents' care. Keep medicines, appointments, documents and the whole family in step, without the group chats and piles of paper.

Kinlog brings your loved ones together around your ageing parents' care. Medicines, appointments, letters and tasks sit in one place the whole family can see, so whether you live round the corner or a few hours away, everyone knows what's happening and who's doing what.

Why Kinlog?

Caring for an ageing parent often lands on one person. You end up holding the list of tablets, the hospital letters, the dates and the phone numbers, while the rest of the family asks you for updates. Kinlog gives all of that a home and shares it, so you're not the only one keeping track.

Key features

Ask Kinlog
Ask a question like "when's Mum's next appointment?" or "which tablets did the doctor change?" and get an answer from your family's record, showing where it came from.

Medicines and reminders
Search the UK medicines list or scan the box label. Set gentle reminders, see today's doses and know when to order more. If a dose was taken late, record the time it was actually taken.

Appointments and visit notes
Keep times, places and the questions you want to ask. Record the appointment and Kinlog turns it into clear notes for the family.

Appointments in your own calendar
Family appointments appear in Google, Outlook or Apple Calendar, next to the rest of your week.

Documents in one place
Scan hospital letters, prescriptions and paperwork (several pages save as one PDF) and find them again when you need them.

Shared tasks
Repeat prescriptions, phone calls and check-ups go on one list, with who's doing what.

Emergency info
Allergies, conditions, medicines, contacts, treatment wishes and who can make decisions, on a one-page sheet ready to show a paramedic.

Care summary and doctor visit pack
Clear PDFs to take to appointments or hand to a carer.

Benefits check
Answer a few plain questions and see which UK benefits may be worth checking for your parent, with the official page to follow up. Kinlog points you to what's worth checking; the official page decides.

Caring hours
Log the time you spend caring and download a 12-week record for a Carer's Allowance claim or a carer's assessment.

Care guides
Step-by-step help for coming home from hospital, after a fall or asking for a carer's assessment, turned into tasks the family can share.

A simple view for your parent
Your parent can have their own view of Kinlog, with today's medicines to mark as taken, their appointments, their emergency info and a tap to call family.

Built for families who share the care

Invite a brother, sister or partner and choose what each person can see and do. Everyone works from the same up-to-date information, so nobody has to ask "did Mum take her tablets?" in the group chat. Add a parent by speaking or typing a few details, and give each parent, or anyone else you look after, their own profile.

Who is Kinlog for?

Sons and daughters looking after ageing parents
Brothers and sisters sharing care between households
Families caring for a parent from a distance
Carers who want the medicines, dates and paperwork in one place

Your privacy

Your family's information is stored securely. There are no ads, and we never sell your data. Kinlog helps you organise everyday care. It doesn't diagnose or give medical advice, and it doesn't replace your parent's doctor or pharmacist.

Download Kinlog and start by adding the medicines your parent takes today.

results.description:
Your parents are ageing. Caring for them should not cost you your own life.

HoldingHands is where a family keeps one shared picture of how Mum and Dad are doing, so the work stops living inside one person's head and one group chat.

WHAT IT DOES EVERY DAY

The morning brief. One message at 7: what medicine was taken yesterday, what is happening today, who is on duty. A quiet day is reported as a quiet day.

Medicines. Every dose, for both parents, with the name of whoever gave it. One tap to confirm. If a dose is missed, the person responsible hears about it first, and you hear about it next.

Appointments. Photograph the clinic letter and the app fills in the date, the department and the fasting note, then asks who is bringing them.

The roster. Duties claimed by name, gaps said out loud, and an honest four week picture of who has been carrying what. It ends the "why is it always me" argument with facts instead of feelings.

Your helper. Her own screen: today's list, big buttons, one tap each, and a photo when something is not clear. She is a professional in the circle, not staff under watch.

Your parent's own screen. Elder Mode has five giant buttons, Chinese first, and what they tap shows up in the family record as theirs. Independence is the point.

The emergency card. Conditions, medicines, allergies, clinic, the people to call. Two taps, works with no signal, prints to wallet size.

Your words. What to say when you have to take the car keys away, hire a helper, split the costs with a brother who does nothing, or sit at a bedside. In English and in Chinese.

The money. Who paid what, tallied every month, split between siblings without screenshots in the chat.

And someone watching how you are doing. Two minutes on a Monday. If your tank is running low, HoldingHands hands one of your duties to someone else and writes the message for you.

WHAT IT WILL NEVER DO

It does not give medical, money or legal advice, and it is not built to. It records and it reminds. Your doctor and your pharmacist advise, and HoldingHands prints them a clean medicine list so every visit starts with the full picture instead of a guess.

BUILT FOR FAMILIES HERE

Care in Singapore and across Asia works differently, and the app is shaped around it: the helper has her own role, Chinese runs through the whole app, both your parents and your in-laws sit in one circle, siblings split the costs, and the sibling overseas gets the picture without calling every Sunday.

WHO SEES WHAT

Every role sees only what it should. A helper never sees documents or money. A doctor sees a consented, read-only summary. The owner can see who looked at what and when. Nothing is sold, rented or shared outside your family, ever. You can download everything and delete everything from inside the app, at any time, without asking anyone.
